pcs.pc_description: Analyse the terms utilized in fire safety such as solid, liquid, and gaseous flammable substances & combustible materials and electrical fires.
Differentiate between exothermic and endothermic reactions, determine the oxygen percentage in air, and ascertain the flash point and fire point.
Register the various sources that pose fire hazards, including sources that provide fuel for fires and sources that can ignite fires.
Identify the Fire triangle & different classes of fire.
Identify the common reason for fire accidents and materials & surroundings assisting spread of fire.
Decipher transmission of fire, heat transfer by conduction, convection, and radiation.
Analyse the four development stages fire- incipient, growth, fully developed and decay.
Interview witnesses with an impartial professional who has expertise in conducting interviews to ensure that the information gathered remains unbiased.

kus: KU1. Incident related definitions & incident terminologies.

KU3. Frequency rate & lost time case rate.

KU5. HAZOP, HIRA & JSA.
KU6. Hierarchy of Control and how it controls hazards at every level.
KU7. Motivational theories in health and safety like Maslows, Hertzberg etc...

pcs.pc_description: Recognise basic definitions- incident, accident, Injury, lost time injury, unsafe condition, unsafe Acts, dangerous occurrences, hazards, error, near miss.
Analyse theories of accident causation- “Heinrich’s Domino theory”, “Heinrich 300-29-1 model, “Ferrell’s Human Factor Model”, “Petersen’s Accident/Incident Model” and Reason’s Swiss Cheese Model”.
Calculate “Frequency rate & Incident rate”. Calculate “Lost time case rate”.
Calculate “DART rate”. Calculate “Severity rate”.
Interpret “Fault tree analysis” and “Event tree analysis”.
Interpret and carryout “HAZOP- Hazard, operability analysis” and “Job safety analysis”.
Interpret “Hazard Identification and risk assessment”.
Analyse the hierarchy of controls, Importance of hierarchy of control & steps in hierarchy of control.
Examine the scene and gather information to establish the origin, cause and circumstances of an incident.
Perform a real-time risk evaluation and grant access to individuals once the area has been deemed secure.
Analyse Maslow’s theory of Hierarchical Needs, Hertzberg’s two-factor theory and McClelland’s theory of needs.
Analyse Vroom’s Theory of Expectancy, McGregor’s theory X and theory Y and Alderfer’s ERG theory.

pcs.pc_description: Interpret fire safety principles prevention, detection and communication, occupant protection, containment and extinguishment.
Identify fire doors, Automatic Fire Suppression Systems (AFSS) Lightening protections, procedures & SOPs.
Prevent fire spread by controlling fuel source, ignition source control and oxygen control.
Interpret principles on which fire extinguishers works: cooling, smothering, starving or by interrupting the combustion process to extinguish the fire.
Analyse different types of extinguishing media-water, foam, dry chemical powder, carbon dioxide.
Analyse types of fire-fighting equipments, its principle of operation.
Perform extinguishing of fire using PASS technique & operation of fire hydrants.
Implement the placement of fire extinguisher at workplace and learn maintenance of fire extinguisher with the help of checklist.
Demarcate fire zone & Restriction on the construction of buildings in each fire zone.
Implement measures such as prohibition of combustible materials, elimination of open fires, utilization of portable fire extinguishers.
Reduce fire load on concrete, use non- combustible ladders, and construct sheds using fire-retardant materials.
Prepare fire plan based on occupancy type, height, and floor area & install fire resistance requirements.
Install fire fighting equipments & fire detection and alarm systems.
Adhere to Regulations for specific materials & develop Emergency preparedness and evacuation plans.

pcs.pc_description: Recognise firefighting system design for water hydrant, sprinklers and pressure requirements in fire hydrants.
Recognise foam system of fire hydrants & design for foam hydrant system.
Prepare smoke detectors, fire alarm, NFPA72, emergency lighting, flashing lights.
Identify fire hoses, fire buckets, fire and welding blankets, flame orb, sand.
Identify requirement of firefighting equipment’s as per IS15683.
Analyse optimum use of smoke detectors, fire alarm, emergency lighting, flashing lights, its location and monitoring.
Identify technological interventions in fire safety like water mist system, online hydrant pressure monitoring, wireless fire detection system etc.
Recognise latest technological development in fire-prevention & detection like, Thermal Imaging & Augmented Reality (AR).
Identify use of PPEs in fire safety – Helmet, turnout gear, gloves & boots etc.
Identify use of SCBA (Self-contained breathing apparatus), respirators, gas masks.
Use and periodical maintain upkeep of PPEs.
Implement measures such as storing flammable materials in designated areas, using explosion-proof electrical equipment & fire suppression systems.
Ensure proper labelling & handling of hazardous chemicals, ventilation of chemical facilities.

pcs.pc_description: Analyse emergencies and emergency evacuations.
Identify the requirements of escape route as per IS1644.
Plan fire door, emergency directional signages, assembly point, evacuation, evacuation of differently abled, evacuation procedure, role of “Fire Marshals”.
Prepare firefighting SOP & drills, equipment deployment, periodical maintenance and mock drills.
Identify local firefighting resources, authority, assistance call from firefighting resources & authorities, communication, assistance to other/neighboring organisations.
Carry out firefighting dills and firefighting equipments.
Prepare evacuation & rescue plan and drills, deployment of fire marshals during evacuation & rescue.
Identify responsibility, control & hierarchy in evacuation, evacuation of differently abled, removal of important documents & deployment of fire marshals during evacuation process.
Carry out on emergency evacuation drills, fire exit and assembly areas.
Maintain vehicle as per manufacturer's specification, multipurpose fire extinguishers, and ensure easy recognition & accessibility.
Adhere to the codes and regulations regarding automobile fire safety, safe driving and materials transportation.

pcs.pc_description: Plan safety resources, schedules, measures and timelines for readiness as per overall work timelines.
Interpret hierarchy of the organisation and communication to other team members, co- workers, subordinates & superiors and coordination with other team members.
Identify and allot task to subordinates, supervision and coordination among the team members for readiness in sync with overall task & timelines.
Resource collection, provisioning of resources to team members as per task & timelines.
Communicate & brief to concerned coworkers, subordinates & superiors, provide guidance to subordinate & co-workers for timely and correct completion.
Supervise & monitor progress of work, reporting the progress & completion, preparation of reports & documents.
Set up medical emergency measures, in case of accidents/incidents at work place.
Set up fire emergency measures as per plans in case of any fire accidents at work place.
Set up emergency assembly area, evacuation plan, sign boards and guidance.
Analyse root causes behind major fire accidents happening around India.

Incorporate insights gained from major incidents like avoiding unauthorized construction, utilization of non-combustible materials, adherence to safety regulations, and creation of emergency response strategies.
